package techversion

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// UpdateTechVersionInput holds update data.
type UpdateTechVersionInput struct {
	ID      int
	Version string
}

// UpdateTechVersion updates tech version fields.
type UpdateTechVersion struct {
	TechVersions repository.TechVersionRepository
}

// Handle updates tech version.
func (uc UpdateTechVersion) Handle(ctx context.Context, in UpdateTechVersionInput) (*domain.TechVersion, error) {
	version := strings.TrimSpace(in.Version)
	if in.ID <= 0 || version == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	techVersion, err := uc.TechVersions.GetByID(ctx, in.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if techVersion.Version == version {
		return techVersion, nil
	}
	techVersion.Version = version
	if err := uc.TechVersions.Update(ctx, *techVersion); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return techVersion, nil
}
